comparison: Explicit F1 comparison: nested 5GB to 10GB background; fixed train/validation labels, K=8, W=unlimited, alpha=kappa=lambda=eta=1, rho=.001; unchanged F1 threshold selection and paired document bootstrap; not an F0.5 evaluation
sampling: Same pinned FineWeb revision and four shards; retain all 5GB background, sample new row groups/rows, then length-stratified selection; unchanged approximate deduplication and candidate quota
storage: Whole-document 25MB blocks; gzip level 1 preserves every integer count; fixed-input query projection is not a general inference benchmark
heldout: Raw heldout text only for duplicate exclusion; no heldout labels, scores, or new teacher inference
